publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the same feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
note:
READ THROUGH THEIR OWN PAGE, holding no credential: Bushel's board is fetched by the customer's site in the reader's browser, so loading that page is the whole of the authorisation. One call to GetBidsList carries every location this operator quotes, so each is a source file and none is new code.

MEASURED BY scripts/bushel-probe.mjs ON 2026-08-25. 17 rows here, and floor-to-the-cent explained EVERY one -- as it did at all 85 locations across the eight Bushel boards that answered. Corn trades in quarter cents and this board displays cash to the whole cent, so residuals come out in quarters; floor makes cash - basis = futures exact again, which is why no tolerance is set and none is wanted.

THE STATE AND STREET ARE NOT IN THE PAYLOAD -- Bushel's location object is {id, name, groups} and nothing else -- so both were read off CHS Illinois's own locations page on 2026-08-25. Not pedantry: this operator's board crosses state lines. CHS Illinois' board carries TWENTY-THREE names and most of them are NOT their elevators: ADM Cedar Rapids, ADM Clinton, CHS Cahokia, GPC Muscatine, Ingredion, Nestle Davenport, Joliet Container Mkt, Ottawa River Mkt, Meredith Rd Elburn and Havana/Beardstown are DELIVERY DESTINATIONS -- places a farmer hauls to -- and 'Futures-Only' is not a place at all. Their own locations page names the ones above as theirs, and only those have a source file. A destination is not a town and must not be geocoded as one. Note their DAVENPORT is in IOWA.
